regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Participating, Non-Linked, Individual Health Plan
variants: Variant 2: Shield with Return of Premium (ROP) — Total Premiums Paid for unclaimed covers returned at maturity
marketing_aliases: Bajaj Life Secure Plus - Shield with ROP Variant
Secure Plus - Shield with ROP Variant
key_benefits: Four optional covers, one or more chosen at inception: Terminal Illness with Term Booster (TI with TB), Accidental Death Benefit (ADB), Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) Benefit, Critical Illness (CI) Benefit
Each cover pays the higher of its Sum Assured or the Guaranteed Benefit (105% of Total Premiums Paid for that cover)
TI with TB: payable on diagnosis of Terminal Illness OR death, whichever occurs first; the TI with TB cover then terminates
ADB: on accidental death, ADB Sum Assured (plus TI with TB Sum Assured if opted); all covers terminate on payment
ATPD: on accidental total permanent disability the ATPD Sum Assured is paid and the remaining covers continue
CI: first diagnosis of a covered critical illness — Critical (10 illnesses), Enhanced (25) or Comprehensive (60) option; 90-day waiting period and 14-day survival period apply
Maturity Benefit ONLY under Variant 2 (Shield with ROP): Total Premiums Paid for the unclaimed cover(s) returned on the Maturity Date if the life assured is alive and the policy is in force
Benefit payout as lump sum, monthly/yearly instalments over 5-40 years, or a combination — chosen at inception, cannot be altered; premium discount equal to the instalment period chosen (5%-40%)
Single, Regular or Limited premium payment; Yearly/Half-yearly/Quarterly/Monthly frequencies
Benefit Enhancer when bought in combination with a Companion Product (e.g. as Bajaj Life Smart Secure ROP with Invest Protect Goal Plus - Elite Variant, UIN 116L215V01)
5% premium rebate for opting more than one cover; female lives get a 3-year age set-back on the TI with TB cover
Health Management Services (medical second opinion, case management, consultation) from registered third-party providers at no additional cost, at the company's discretion

eligibility.max_entry_age_note: Single Pay for TI with TB: maximum entry age 50 years
eligibility.max_sum_assured: No limit, subject to Board Approved Underwriting Policy
eligibility.policy_term: Variant 1 Shield: Single Pay 1-67 years (CI: 1-30), Regular Pay = PPT, Limited Pay PPT+1 to 67 years (CI: to 30). Variant 2 Shield with ROP: Single Pay 10-67 years (CI: 10-30), Regular Pay = PPT, Limited Pay PPT+5 to 67 years (CI: to 30)
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single Pay 1 year; Variant 1 Regular 2-67 / Limited 2-66 years (CI: Regular 2-30, Limited 2-29); Variant 2 Regular 10-67 / Limited 5-62 years (CI: Regular 10-30, Limited 5-25)
eligibility.premium_frequency: Single, Yearly, Half-yearly, Quarterly, Monthly (frequency factors 1 / 0.5084 / 0.2564 / 0.0859)
eligibility.note: Sold through online mode. Variant and payout option are chosen at inception and cannot be changed during the policy term.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise), except policies with tenure under a year; refund less proportionate risk premium, medical-examination expenses and stamp duty, within 7 days of the request.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for frequencies other than monthly; 15 days for monthly. Cover continues during the grace period; unpaid premium is deducted from any benefit.
key_terms.suicide_clause: ADB is not payable on death by suicide; ATPD excludes attempted self-injury; CI excludes intentional self-inflicted injury, suicide or attempted suicide. Death by suicide is otherwise dealt with per the policy document.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: Guaranteed Benefit for each cover = 105% of Total Premiums Paid with respect to that cover; each cover pays the higher of its Sum Assured or the Guaranteed Benefit.
key_terms.waiting_period_note: CI: no benefit if the critical illness is diagnosed within 90 days of the start of cover; the insured must survive 14 days from diagnosis.
key_terms.surrender_note: Variant 1 Shield: no termination value under Regular Pay; Termination Value (Termination Factor x Total Premiums Paid, factors not guaranteed) after the PPT under Limited Pay and immediately under Single Pay. Variant 2 Shield with ROP: higher of GSV (GSV Factor x Total Premiums Paid, guaranteed) or SSV (not guaranteed, reviewed against 10-year G-Sec + 50 bps), capped at 100% of Total Premiums Paid.
key_terms.paid_up_note: Variant 2 only: a policy that has acquired surrender value becomes paid-up on non-payment; paid-up sum assured is never lower than 105% of Total Premiums Paid for each cover.
key_terms.revival_note: Within 5 years of the first unpaid premium and before the end of the policy term; arrears plus interest (currently 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly, benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%).
key_terms.loan_note: No policy loan facility is described in the brochure.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per applicable tax laws, subject to amendment; GST applicable per prevailing law.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Cover-wise exclusions (ADB, ATPD, CI) including the CI waiting and survival periods
Grievance redressal (company, IRDAI IGCC, Bima Bharosa, Ombudsman)
Section 38 Assignment, Section 39 Nomination, Section 41 Prohibition of Rebate, Section 45 Fraud & Misstatement
Beware of spurious phone calls warning

claims_marketing_must_support: 'Get your premiums back' / 'Return of Premium' / 'ROP' claims apply ONLY to Variant 2 (Shield with ROP), ONLY for covers that have not been claimed, and ONLY on survival to the Maturity Date with the policy in force — Variant 1 (Shield) has NO maturity benefit.
Any critical-illness claim must name the option (Critical 10 / Enhanced 25 / Comprehensive 60) and cannot hide the 90-day waiting period and 14-day survival period.
ADB and ATPD claims must be bound to accidental cause; death or disability from disease or infection is excluded.
'Terminal illness' benefit is an accelerated cover — paying it on diagnosis terminates the TI with TB cover; it is not an additional payout on top of the same cover.
Guaranteed-benefit language must be tied to the 105%-of-premiums floor per cover, not to a guaranteed return on money.
Instalment payout options and the associated premium discount are chosen at inception and cannot be altered.
Any 'health services' / second-opinion claim must state the services are optional, provided by third parties, and may be discontinued.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position this as a savings, investment, wealth-creation or market-linked product — it is a non-linked, non-participating individual HEALTH plan.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating.
Do NOT imply a maturity benefit or premium refund without the Shield-with-ROP variant qualification.
Do NOT present it as a comprehensive life-insurance term plan — death is covered only through the covers chosen (TI with TB pays on death or terminal illness; ADB only on accidental death).
Do NOT promise coverage for all critical illnesses — coverage is limited to the illnesses listed under the chosen option.
Do NOT omit that only one variant can be chosen at inception and that it cannot be changed.

Do NOT describe Bajaj Life Smart Secure ROP as a single product — it is a combination offering of this plan's Shield with ROP variant with Bajaj Life Invest Protect Goal Plus - Elite Variant (UIN 116L215V01); combination collateral must carry both UINs and both regulatory descriptors.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: A Non-Participating, Non-Linked, Individual Health Plan
Variant qualification (Shield vs Shield with ROP) on any maturity/premium-return claim
CI waiting period (90 days) and survival period (14 days) wherever critical illness is promoted
Standard disclaimer to read the sales brochure, benefit illustration and policy document for full terms and exclusions
